technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Polo (9N), Seat Ibiza (6L), Skoda Fabia (6Y) or similar:
If 01309 is stored in multiple Control Modules and the Steering Aid (#44/J500) does not communicate with the Scan tool, Kontrol edin: the Steering Aid Control Module Power Supply. Assuming the Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantılarıd Power Supplies (typically 2 fuses are used) are OK, in almost all cases the actual Steering Rack (containing the Control Module) is faulty and needs to be replaced. Be aware that there are different Suppliers for these Parts and make sure to order your Değiştirin / Yenileyin: ment accordingly.
If fuse SB7 is blown Kontrol edin: to see if another component on that circuit, such as N79 (Heater element for crankcase breather), is faulty.
